# Research Guides at Boston Public Library

> Boston Public Library's comprehensive research guides portal offering curated access to digital collections, primary sources, subject-specific resources, and community research tools.

Research Guides at Boston Public Library provides librarian-curated guides covering local history, LGBTQ+ resources, intellectual property, performing arts, and specialized research collections. The site serves as a knowledge base for accessing BPL's extensive digital resources, rare books, and archival materials.

## Key Topics

- Boston Public Library
- Digital collections
- Primary sources
- Local history
- LGBTQ+ history
- Library catalog
- Research guides
- Special collections
- Digital Commonwealth
- Boston history
- Intellectual property
- Music research
- Historical maps
- Subject directories
- Library resources

## Getting Started

- [Home - Research Guides at Boston Public Library](https://guides.bpl.org): Boston Public Library research guides homepage and portal directory
- [Online Resources](https://guides.bpl.org/az.php): BPL online databases and digital resources directory by subject
- [Using the Library Catalog](https://guides.bpl.org/catalog): How-to guide for searching the BPL library catalog

## Primary Sources & Historical Research

- [Getting Started with Primary Sources](https://guides.bpl.org/primarysources): Guide to finding and using primary sources at Boston Public Library
- [Boston Historical Address Research](https://guides.bpl.org/bostonaddresses): Research guide for Boston historical addresses and local history
- [Historical Urban Atlases of Massachusetts Towns](https://guides.bpl.org/mass-urban-atlases): Guide to historical urban atlases and maps of Massachusetts towns
- [Boston's LGBTQ+ History](https://guides.bpl.org/LGBTQhistory): Research guide to Boston's LGBTQ+ history and archival resources

## Subject-Specific Guides

- [Music at the BPL](https://guides.bpl.org/musicref): Getting started guide for music research at Boston Public Library
- [Performing Arts Materials on Microfilm](https://guides.bpl.org/performingarts): Guide to performing arts microfilm collections at BPL
- [Copyright/Creative Commons, Trademarks, and Patents](https://guides.bpl.org/intellectualproperty): Research guide to intellectual property, copyright, patents, trademarks
- [Researching Antiques and Collectibles](https://guides.bpl.org/researchantiques): Guide to researching antiques, collectibles, pricing, and appraisals

## Community & Social Resources

- [LGBTQ+ Youth & Adult Resources](https://guides.bpl.org/QUILTBAG): LGBTQ+ youth and adult resources guide from Boston Public Library
- [Reentry Resources for Returning Citizens](https://guides.bpl.org/reentry): Resources for returning citizens including housing, employment, legal services
- [Book Discussion Groups: An Introductory Guide](https://guides.bpl.org/bookdiscussiongroups): Guide to joining or starting book discussion groups at BPL
